items.title: Pointwise characterizations of geometric regularity by purely inseparable base change and by the local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a locally Noetherian scheme X over k and a point x, the lemma proves the equivalence of geometric regularity at x, regularity of the local rings at all points above x after every finite purely inseparable base change, and geometric regularity of the local ring O_{X,x} over k (statement lines 2381-2396). The proof is a short cycle. From the second condition to the third, the author observes that localizing a finite purely inseparable extension keeps the spectrum a single point, so the tensor product O_{X,x} tensor_k k' is local and equals the local ring at the unique point above x, which is regular by hypothesis (proof lines 2400-2410). From the third to the first, an arbitrary field extension is used: surjectivity of the base change gives a point x' above x, and the local ring there is a localization of O_{X,x} tensor_k k', hence regular (proof lines 2413-2420). The first condition implies the second by definition. The claim is H2: three short steps whose content is the uniqueness of the point above x under a purely inseparable extension and the localization description of the local ring there.
